description: This PHP source file defines an interface 'ReportSearchFilterParams' within the 'OrangeHRM' system. The interface specifies methods for retrieving various filter parameters used in report search functionalities, such as report ID, sort order, sort field, limit, and offset.

methods.name: getReportId
methods.description: Returns the report ID as an integer.

methods.name: getSortOrder
methods.description: Returns the sort order string, referencing FilterParams::getSortOrder().

methods.name: getSortField
methods.description: Returns the sort field as a string or null, referencing FilterParams::getSortField().

methods.name: getLimit
methods.description: Returns the limit as an integer, referencing FilterParams::getLimit().

methods.name: getOffset
methods.description: Returns the offset as an integer, referencing FilterParams::getOffset().
